issue: Two DIARRHOEA AE records have identical start/end dates (2013-05-21 to 2013-05-26), severity and relationship, but conflicting outcomes (one NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED despite an end date, one RECOVERED/RESOLVED).
query_text: Two Adverse Event records for DIARRHOEA are entered with the same start date (2013-05-21), end date (2013-05-26), severity (Mild) and relationship (Possible). AE record 1 shows outcome "NOT RECOVERED/NOT RESOLVED" even though it has an end date of 2013-05-26. AE record 2 shows outcome "RECOVERED/RESOLVED". Could you please confirm whether these are two separate episodes or one duplicated entry? If it is a duplicate, please remove the extra record. If they are separate, please check the dates and the outcome on record 1 so that they agree.

issue: Amlodipine 5 mg started 2013-05-27 for HYPERTENSION, and supine SBP was 160-176 mmHg from screening, but hypertension is not on Medical History or Adverse Events.
query_text: Concomitant medication AMLODIPINE 5 mg was started on 2013-05-27 with the indication "HYPERTENSION". Supine systolic blood pressure was already 176 mmHg at Screening 1 (2013-04-20), 166 mmHg at Screening 2 (2013-04-25) and 160 mmHg at Baseline (2013-04-27). However, hypertension is not recorded on the Medical History form or on the Adverse Events form. Please confirm whether hypertension was present before the study, in which case please add it to Medical History. If it started or worsened during the study, should it be reported as an adverse event? Please update the relevant form or explain.

issue: Nine identical IMODIUM 2 mg entries start 2013-05-21 with no indication and no end date, although the related diarrhoea AE ended 2013-05-26.
query_text: Nine Concomitant Medication records for IMODIUM (loperamide) 2 mg are entered with the same start date (2013-05-21). None has an indication or an end date. The DIARRHOEA adverse events that started on 2013-05-21 are recorded as ending on 2013-05-26. Please confirm whether these nine records are separate administrations or duplicate entries. Please also add the indication, and either an end date or confirm that the medication was ongoing.
